newsitem.title: USA: IBM shares fall after NYSE delay lifted.
newsitem.headline: IBM shares fall after NYSE delay lifted.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp began New York Stock Exchange trade Wednesday with a 14-3/4 point decline to 155 after a 25-minute order-imbalance delay was lifted.
The IBM decline, driven by the company's disappointing fourth quarter earnings report last night, immediately knocked the Dow Jones Industrial average down to about 6816, off 68 points.
The IBM sell-off accounted for about two-thirds of the Dow decline.
Subsequent NYSE morning trade brought a partial IBM rebound to 159-1/8, a deficit of 10-1/4 or six percent.
IBM was by far the most-active NYSE issue with over four million shares traded by 1020 EST/1520 GMT.
Meanwhile, the Dow Jones Industrial average regained some lost ground to notch a 50-point loss at 6833.
